propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) triggers delete_issue on a successfully-created Jira issue, destroying recoverable work
The keyed-pending binding is recorded before identity writes but never unbound on rollback, stranding the ticket permanently as subsequent retro-attach attempts fail against a deleted key
The recover_pending keyed branch already implements deterministic retro-attach without search and is designed for the crash-in-create-label window, making the rollback delete redundant
Jira rejects identity writes with misleading screen-not-found errors in at least three situations: field not on screen, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, or malformed field value
The issue must be retained and left keyed-pending for retro-attach recovery instead of deleted, with error messaging declaring the Create/Edit screen requirement for labels
